title: Hidalgo Research Consulting Privacy Policy
text:
Hidalgo Research Consulting
Last Updated: 11/20/2025
This privacy policy describes how Hidalgo Research Consulting (“we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and protects information in connection with our academic research activities, including recruitment through social media platforms and survey administration.


Survey Responses: When you participate in one of our research surveys, we collect your responses to survey questions. Surveys may be administered through third-party platforms (such as Qualtrics) or through messaging services (such as WhatsApp).
Contact Identifiers: If you interact with us through WhatsApp or other messaging platforms, we may collect your phone number or platform identifier for the purpose of delivering survey invitations and conducting research communications.
Recruitment and Advertising Data: When we conduct recruitment through social media advertising platforms, we define targeting parameters (such as geographic region or demographic characteristics) to reach potential research participants. We do not receive or store individual-level data about users who view our advertisements unless they choose to participate in our research.



We use collected information for academic research purposes, including:

Administering surveys and collecting responses
Communicating with research participants
Analyzing data to produce research findings
Publishing research results in academic venues




We may share de-identified or anonymized data with research collaborators and research assistants for the purpose of conducting and publishing research. We do not sell your information or share identifiable data with third parties for commercial purposes.
Published research findings will contain only anonymous, aggregated data that cannot be used to identify individual participants.
We do not share contact identifiers (such as WhatsApp phone numbers) with any third parties.



We retain identifiable information only as long as necessary to complete the research for which it was collected. Identifiable data is deleted following the publication of research related to that data. Anonymous or de-identified data may be retained indefinitely for research purposes.



You may request deletion of any personal data we hold about you by contacting us at contact@hidalgo-research.com. We will respond to deletion requests within 30 days.



Our research activities may involve third-party platforms including Meta (Facebook, WhatsApp), Qualtrics, and others. These platforms have their own privacy policies governing their collection and use of data. This policy applies only to information that Hidalgo Research Consulting collects and controls.



We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be noted by updating the “Last Updated” date above.



If you have questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at:
contact@hidalgo-research.com
Hidalgo Research Consulting
Cambridge, MA

title: Hidalgo Research
text:
Survey Research & Digital Recruitment
Hidalgo Research Consulting provides research consulting services specializing in survey methodology and digital recruitment strategies.
Our expertise includes:

Social media advertising for survey recruitment (Meta platforms, WhatsApp Business API)
Stratified sampling and adaptive quota management
Survey research in Latin American contexts
Multilingual survey implementation

Principal affiliated with MIT Political Science Department.

Address: 79 Norfolk St, Cambridge, MA 02139
Phone: 510-708-7777

title: F. Daniel Hidalgo
text: F. Daniel Hidalgo is an Associate Professor of Political Science (with tenure) at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he has been a faculty member since 2012. He earned his Ph.D. from the University of California at Berkeley in 2012 and his B.A. Magna cum Laude from Princeton University in 2002.

title: F. Daniel Hidalgo
text: F. Daniel Hidalgo is an Associate Professor of Political Science (with tenure) at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he has been a faculty member since 2012. He earned his Ph.D. from the University of California at Berkeley in 2012 and his B.A. Magna cum Laude from Princeton University in 2002.

title: F. Daniel Hidalgo
text:
Research Expertise
Professor Hidalgo’s research focuses on comparative politics and political methodology, with particular expertise in:

Electoral accountability and political representation
Survey research methods and experimental design
Digital recruitment strategies for hard-to-reach populations
Latin American politics, with extensive fieldwork in Brazil
Causal inference and quantitative methods

His work has been published in leading journals including the American Journal of Political Science, Journal of Politics, American Political Science Review, British Journal of Political Science, and Comparative Political Studies. He received the 2017 James Caporaso Best Paper award and the 2014 Kellogg/Notre Dame Award for best paper in comparative politics.

title: F. Daniel Hidalgo
text:

Former Academic Director, MIT GOV/LAB (2019-2023)

title: F. Daniel Hidalgo
text:
Hidalgo Research Consulting
Hidalgo Research Consulting provides specialized research consulting services focused on survey methodology and digital recruitment for Latin American populations. Services include:

Social media advertising for survey recruitment (Meta platforms, WhatsApp Business API)
Stratified sampling and adaptive quota management
Multi-country survey projects in Latin American contexts
Multilingual survey implementation
Digital recruitment strategies for complex populations

Professor Hidalgo brings over 15 years of experience conducting field experiments and surveys in Latin America, with fluency in Spanish and Portuguese.
